ui.description: Interactive 3D assembly instructions for the bGeigie Zen.
ui.flipTitle: Look at the other side of the board
ui.canvasLabel: 3D assembly view. Drag to rotate, shift-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
ui.coverSub: Step-by-step 3D assembly: case, battery, GM tube, mainboard, GPS and display.
ui.coverHint: Drag to rotate · Shift-drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · ← → to change step
ui.credit: bGeigie Zen is a {creator} open hardware project. Viewer layout after the APS-II Sesame build guide.

orient-the-case.title: Orient the case
orient-the-case.text: Place the enclosure base on the bench, open side up. The USB-C side is on the right.

fit-the-battery.title: Fit the battery
fit-the-battery.text: Lower the LiPo cell into the left half of the base, label up. Route its lead toward the middle.

notes.model: Placeholder geometry and dimensions; replace with the real CAD before publishing.

fit-the-tube.title: Fit the GM tube
fit-the-tube.text: Seat the pancake Geiger–Müller tube in the right half of the base with its mica window facing up.

notes.model: Placeholder geometry and dimensions; replace with the real CAD before publishing.

mount-the-standoffs.title: Mount the standoffs
mount-the-standoffs.text: Screw the four M3 standoffs into the corner posts of the base.

seat-the-mainboard.title: Seat the mainboard
seat-the-mainboard.text: Lower the main PCB onto the standoffs and fasten it with four screws. The battery and tube sit underneath.

esp32-headers.title: ESP32 headers
esp32-headers.text: Fit two 9-pin male headers under the ESP32 module, long ends down.

solder-the-esp32.title: Solder the ESP32
solder-the-esp32.text: Solder every header pin on the module’s top face.

seat-the-esp32.title: Seat the ESP32
seat-the-esp32.text: Plug the module into the mainboard sockets, antenna toward the board edge.

build-the-gps.title: Build the GPS
build-the-gps.text: Solder the six header pins of the GPS module. The ceramic patch antenna faces up.

seat-the-gps.title: Seat the GPS
seat-the-gps.text: Plug the GPS module into its socket.

hv-module.title: HV module
hv-module.text: Solder the high-voltage supply to the mainboard and connect its output lead to the tube.

notes.info: Handle the HV module only with power off and the battery unplugged.

display-and-usb.title: Display and USB-C
display-and-usb.text: Solder the OLED display and the USB-C connector. The display must line up with the lid window.

connect-the-battery.title: Connect the battery
connect-the-battery.text: Solder the battery lead to the mainboard from underneath. Check polarity first.

notes.info: Keep the lead short and insulated from the tube.

close-the-case.title: Close the case
close-the-case.text: Lower the lid, display through the window, and fasten it.

assembly-complete.title: Assembly complete
assembly-complete.text: Power on and check the display, GPS fix and counts before field use.
